headerDisplay: Exposes a UPS managed by [apcupsd](http://www.apcupsd.org/) to HomeKit. apcupsd must have its Network Information Server enabled (`NETSERVER on` in `/etc/apcupsd/apcupsd.conf`).

host.title: apcupsd host
host.description: Hostname or IP of the machine running apcupsd. Leave empty if it runs on the Homebridge server.

port.title: apcupsd port
port.description: Leave empty to use apcupsd's default NIS port (3551).

temperatureSensor.title: Expose a temperature sensor
temperatureSensor.description: Publishes the UPS internal temperature (apcupsd's ITEMP value). Only Smart-UPS models report it; Back-UPS and most consumer models don't, and would show 0 °C.

interval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
interval.description: How often the UPS status is read. Lower values detect power cuts sooner.

errorLogsOnly.title: Only log errors
errorLogsOnly.description: Hide the informational log lines (power, battery and charging state changes).

model.title: Model
model.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

serial.title: Serial number
serial.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

firmwareRevision.title: Firmware revision
firmwareRevision.description: Only used if the UPS doesn't report it.

layout.title: Accessory information
layout.description: Normally filled in automatically from what the UPS reports.
